headerDisplay: Local control of an EO Mini Pro 2 / EO Smart Home Hub running [OpenEO](https://github.com/minceheid/openeo). Leave the address blank to find the charger automatically.

host.title: Charger address
host.description: Leave blank to find the charger automatically, or enter its IP (e.g. 192.168.1.50). A fixed IP is more reliable across VLANs.

discoverySubnets.title: Extra subnets to search
discoverySubnets.description: Only used when the address is blank. Add the charger's subnet if it's on a different VLAN (comma-separated).

matter.title: Publish over Matter with energy reporting
matter.description: Needs Homebridge 2.2+ with a 'matter' block on this bridge (child bridge recommended). The charger appears as a Matter outlet whose power and kWh show in Apple Home's Energy view. Falls back to a HomeKit outlet automatically.

matterDeviceType.title: Matter device type
matterDeviceType.description: EV charger uses Matter's proper EV charger type: charging on/off, current limit, charging mode (manual / timer / solar), session energy and faults. It isn't yet known how Apple Home shows it, so the HomeKit on/off outlet is kept alongside. Changing this means re-adding the Matter accessory in the Home app.

hapOutletWithMatter.title: Also keep the HomeKit outlet when Matter is on
hapOutletWithMatter.description: Usually off - otherwise you get two charger tiles.

defaultAmps.title: Default charge current (A)
defaultAmps.description: Used when turning charging on if OpenEO has no manual current set yet.

exposeCurrentControl.title: Show 'Charge Current' control (fan slider)
exposeCurrentControl.description: HomeKit has no amps control, so this appears as a fan: speed % = current out of 32A (min 6A).

exposeFaultSensor.title: Show 'Charger Problem' sensor
exposeFaultSensor.description: A contact sensor that opens if the charger reports a mains fault or goes offline. Turn on its notifications in the Home app.
